updated_note: Edited by hand at the end of each stage; the page builder reads it.

stages.name: One split with a trained encoder
stages.question: Does the paper's single split work in our own code?
stages.result: Yes. Passes on all 5 seeds. The authors' own script also run: our numbers are close to theirs (about 0.01 lower on R²).

stages.name: Split a second time
stages.question: B1: does the second split work given correct pairs? B2: can those pairs be built from the data?
stages.result: B1: second split works with correct pairs (15 seeds). B2: pairs built by clustering work when categories are many and fine (12: 4-5 degrees), fail with few (3), and are mixed at 6; my world design hurts the few-category cases.

stages.name: Deeper ladder and scaling
stages.question: How many levels hold up, and does error shrink with more data?

stages.name: Does it help?
stages.question: Does the ladder beat other methods at the same cost?
